narrator: Mina Harker, Van Helsing (memorandum), Jonathan Harker, Dr. Seward
summary: Van Helsing and Mina drive up to the Borgo Pass changing horses daily while Mina's trances fade into drowsiness and she begins to behave oddly (eats alone, sleeps all day, looks redder and healthier). At the Pass she knows the road from Jonathan's diary. Near the castle Van Helsing draws a holy circle with crumbled Host wafer; Mina cannot leave it, and the three Brides appear in snow and mist begging her to come to them but cannot cross. The horses die. Next day Van Helsing enters the ruined castle with a blacksmith's hammer, finds the three Brides in their tombs, fights the fascination, stakes and beheads them, and lays wafer in Dracula's empty tomb, then seals the doors. Meanwhile Harker and Godalming, and Seward and Morris, converge on a gypsy party racing a leiter-wagon with the box toward the castle at sunset. In a pitched fight Jonathan's kukri slashes the Count's throat and Morris's bowie pierces the heart; Dracula crumbles to dust. Morris, stabbed, dies blessing Mina whose scar has vanished.

scenes.title: Driving to the Borgo Pass
scenes.location: Road from Veresti to the Carpathians
scenes.summary: They change horses often, pay farmers, eat hot soup. Villagers make the sign of the evil eye at Mina's scar and add garlic to the food. A rude four-in-hand is assembled.
scenes.key_quote: she crossed herself and put out two fingers towards me, to keep off the evil eye.

scenes.title: Mina Knows the Way
scenes.location: Borgo Pass and the old by-road
scenes.summary: At the Pass Mina sees the right road from Jonathan's journal. She sleeps all day; at dusk she is suspiciously bright and says she has already eaten.
scenes.key_quote: “Have not my Jonathan travelled it and wrote of his travel?”

scenes.title: The Holy Circle Night
scenes.location: Camp below Castle Dracula, snow and mist
scenes.summary: Van Helsing draws a ring and crumbles the Host over it; Mina cannot step out. The horses scream and cower; mist and snow form the three women who beg Mina to come. Van Helsing holds firewood and wafer toward them; at dawn they dissolve and the horses are found dead.
scenes.key_quote: “Come, sister. Come to us. Come! Come!”

scenes.title: Staking the Brides
scenes.summary: Van Helsing breaks open the rusted doors with the blacksmith's hammer, finds the chapel, searches tombs, resists the fascination, hears Mina's wail, and stakes and beheads all three. He places wafer in Dracula's empty tomb and seals the castle entrances.
scenes.key_quote: Oh, my friend John, but it was butcher work

scenes.title: The Hollow in the Rocks
scenes.location: Rocky hollow downhill from the castle
scenes.summary: They descend, rest, and Van Helsing finds a natural hollow between two boulders as a shelter, draws a circle around the rock, and sights the approaching gypsies and the pursuers through field glasses.
scenes.key_quote: here you will be in shelter; and if the wolves do come I can meet them one by one.

scenes.title: Pursuit Across the Snow
scenes.location: Snowy slopes toward the Borgo Pass
scenes.summary: The launch group abandons the boat and takes horses; Seward sees the Szgany with the leiter-wagon racing from the river, wolves howling.
scenes.key_quote: We ride to death of some one.

scenes.title: The Final Battle at Sunset
scenes.location: Plain below Dracula's castle, between the hollow and the road
scenes.summary: Four men with Winchesters surround the gypsies; Van Helsing and Mina cover from the rock. Jonathan and Quincey break through the knife ring, throw the box from the cart, pry the lid with kukri and bowie; as the sun touches the mountains Jonathan cuts the Count's throat and Quincey stabs his heart; he turns to dust. Gypsies flee, wolves follow.
scenes.key_quote: before our very eyes, and almost in the drawing of a breath, the whole body crumbled into dust and passed from our sight.

scenes.title: Quincey's Death
scenes.summary: Wounded in the side, Morris is held by Jonathan; the setting sun lights Mina's forehead, now unmarked. He dies content.
scenes.key_quote: See! the snow is not more stainless than her forehead! The curse has passed away!

locations.quote: all is oh! so wild and rocky, as though it were the end of the world.

locations.name: Camp below the castle (Holy circle)

locations.quote: I drew a ring so big for her comfort, round where Madam Mina sat

locations.name: Castle Dracula (exterior)
locations.description: Broken battlements on a summit of a sheer precipice a thousand feet up, with a gap between it and the adjoining mountain.
locations.quote: perched a thousand feet on the summit of a sheer precipice

locations.name: Castle chapel and tombs
locations.description: Old chapel with age-fretted tombs under centuries of dust, sulphurous odour, and one huge noble tomb lettered DRACULA.
locations.quote: On it was but one word DRACULA.

locations.name: Rock hollow shelter
locations.description: Natural hollow in rock with doorway-like entrance between two boulders; vantage rock above.
locations.quote: a sort of natural hollow in a rock, with an entrance like a doorway between two boulders.

locations.name: Plain below the castle
locations.description: White snowy waste with the river a black ribbon in kinks and curls, poor road with deep ruts.
locations.quote: I could see the river lying like a black ribbon in kinks and curls

locations.name: Farmhouse/Veresti stages
locations.description: Stop-over houses where horses are changed and food served.
locations.quote: We get hot soup, or coffee, or tea; and off we go.

creatures.name: The three Brides
creatures.description: Three vampire women (two fair, one dark) formerly seen in Harker's castle room, now in tombs by day.
creatures.behaviour: By night appear as snow and mist taking shape, lure Mina, circle the Holy ring.
creatures.quote: the wheeling figures of mist and snow came closer, but keeping ever without the Holy circle.

creatures.quote: the wolves were gathering for their prey.

creatures.behaviour: Race for the sunset, scatter after the Count turns to dust.
creatures.quote: turned, without a word, and rode away as if for their lives.

creatures.quote: the whole body crumbled into dust and passed from our sight.

vampire_lore.detail: Vampires cannot enter the ring; the tainted Mina cannot leave it.
vampire_lore.quote: which she could not leave no more than they could enter.

vampire_lore.rule: Host wafer in a tomb banishes a vampire permanently
vampire_lore.detail: Placed in Dracula's tomb so he cannot return.
vampire_lore.quote: I laid in Dracula’s tomb some of the Wafer, and so banished him from it, Un-Dead, for ever.

vampire_lore.rule: Vampires materialise from mist and snow
vampire_lore.detail: Brides take shape from snow flurries and mist at night.
vampire_lore.quote: the snow-flurries and the wreaths of mist took shape as of women with trailing garments.

vampire_lore.detail: Staring at sleeping vampires paralyses the will; delay until sunset is fatal.
vampire_lore.quote: the mere beauty and the fascination of the wanton Un-Dead have hypnotise him

vampire_lore.rule: Staking and beheading destroys them; bodies crumble
vampire_lore.detail: Stake drives with screeching, head cut, body turns to dust; face shows peace.
vampire_lore.quote: the whole body began to melt away and crumble in to its native dust

vampire_lore.rule: Mina's hypnosis fails nearer the castle and she becomes drowsy by day
vampire_lore.detail: Increasing vampire taint; sleeps in day, wakes bright at night, refuses food, eats alone.
vampire_lore.quote: the power has grown less and less with each day

vampire_lore.detail: Van Helsing advances with firewood and wafer; they draw back laughing.
vampire_lore.quote: They drew back before me, and laughed their low horrid laugh.

vampire_lore.detail: Horses scream, cower, and die of fear; calmed by human touch.
vampire_lore.quote: the horses began to scream, and tore at their tethers

vampire_lore.detail: At sunset the Count in his box takes new freedom and can elude pursuit.
vampire_lore.quote: at sunset the Thing, which was till then imprisoned there, would take new freedom

vampire_lore.rule: Death of the Count removes Mina's mark
vampire_lore.detail: When Dracula dies the scar vanishes.
vampire_lore.quote: the snow is not more stainless than her forehead! The curse has passed away!
some sulphurous fume, which at times made me dizzy.

puzzles.name: Reading Jonathan's diary as a map
puzzles.setup: Mina must find the unmarked by-road from the Pass.
puzzles.book_solution: Mina recognises the right road from Jonathan's diary; horses are given rein.
puzzles.game_idea: Navigation puzzle: match diary landmark descriptions against terrain at each fork.
puzzles.quote: I see that there be only one such by-road.

puzzles.name: Keep the fire and the circle
puzzles.obstacle: Fire dying in the cold hour; leaving the ring is fatal.
puzzles.book_solution: Stay within the circle, feed fire from within reach, hold the wafer.
puzzles.game_idea: Survival defence: ration wood and wafer while waves of mist-forms test the ring edges; hold horses calm.
puzzles.quote: Do not go without. Here you are safe!

puzzles.name: Resist the fascination
puzzles.obstacle: Their beauty puts the hunter into a trance.
puzzles.book_solution: Van Helsing hears Mina's wail; avoids looking too long.
puzzles.game_idea: Willpower meter: each second looking costs willpower; use quick actions to proceed.
puzzles.quote: I dared not pause to look on her as I had on her sister

puzzles.name: Find all the tombs
puzzles.book_solution: Search every tomb; three Un-Dead matched the three phantoms; Dracula's tomb is empty and gets wafer.
puzzles.game_idea: Chapel search puzzle with three active tombs and one empty lordly tomb.
puzzles.quote: By this time I had searched all the tombs in the chapel

puzzles.name: Seal the castle
puzzles.book_solution: Van Helsing breaks the doors off their hinges (the Wafer fixes the entrances).
puzzles.game_idea: Ritual sealing minigame at each entrance.
puzzles.quote: I so fixed its entrances that never more can the Count enter there Un-Dead.

puzzles.name: Reaching the cart before sunset
puzzles.setup: Box on cart racing to the castle.
puzzles.book_solution: Converge from four sides, cover with rifles, break through to the box and pry it open.
puzzles.game_idea: Timed boss approach: sun clock decreases as you cut through gypsy ring.

combat.name: Siege of the Holy Circle
combat.tactics: Stay inside ring, keep fire alive, advance with wafer only to repulse; the Brides cannot cross the ring.
combat.outcome: Brides dissolve at dawn; horses dead.
combat.game_idea: Wave-defence puzzle: protect Mina and the ring integrity, manage fire fuel and wafer uses.
combat.quote: They could not approach, me, whilst so armed

combat.name: Staking the three Brides
combat.tactics: Open each tomb, resist fascination, stake, behead.
combat.outcome: Brides turn to dust; wafer in Dracula's tomb.
combat.game_idea: Three sequential mini-bosses in sleep: willpower bar versus time; stake timing minigame.
combat.quote: I could not have endured the horrid screeching as the stake drove home

combat.name: Battle of the cart at sunset
enemy_types: Szgany gypsies with knives and pistols
combat.tactics: Encircle with rifle cover, two fighters rush the cart; break through gypsy ring; pry box open before sunset; behead and pierce heart.
combat.outcome: Count turns to dust; Morris fatally wounded.
combat.game_idea: Party turn-based encounter: Winchester pair suppress (cover), two melee characters push through, sun timer counts rounds; final attack on the box ends fight, Morris suffers a wound.
combat.quote: Jonathan’s impetuosity, and the manifest singleness of his purpose, seemed to overawe those in front of him

quest_hooks: Escort Mina to the castle and keep her inside the circle each night.
Chapel sequence: find and destroy the Brides one by one without falling to their spell.
Seal Dracula's tomb with wafer and lock the castle entrances.
Final chase: decide which party members take which routes to converge on the cart before sunset.
Choose who takes the fatal wound (Quincey) or whether a different character is sacrificed.
Optional branch: Mina's drowsiness and dusk eating hint at a bad ending if the Count is not killed in time.
